whatThisIs: A genuine session-native model interpretation (captured, hash-verified) feeding the REAL deterministic six-stage control plane and N7->N8 output guard, with a full append-only audit chain.
whatThisIsNot: NOT an in-application live model SDK integration (probed and BLOCKED this cycle)

channel: session-native Agent subagent (general-purpose) — real model inference through the platform-supported subagent interface
costAndCredentials: 0 accounts created, 0 credits consumed, 0 credentials read/exposed, 0 paid billing, 0 network calls to any model API
trustBoundary: The model sees ONLY an authorised-citation context per case (or none). It never reaches the permission table, full corpus, restricted items, tools, approval gate or audit writer. Its output must pass the deterministic N7->N8 guard before any answer is returned.
blockedInAppLivePath: In-app live SDK path probed and BLOCKED this cycle: `the in-app SDK probe` headless variants all EXIT=124 / 0 bytes (60s); no local model weights; no model API credential or endpoint. Enabling requires owner-gated G1-G6.

mandatoryBehaviours.A2: authorisation BEFORE search; permitted data only; access-change reactivity
mandatoryBehaviours.A3: restricted refusal without existence hint; PERSIS SAMA
mandatoryBehaviours.A4: conflicting sources flagged; selected value + reason stated
mandatoryBehaviours.A6: every question, retrieved sources and returned answer logged (append-only)
